$comment: Stage spec: scoping / ROE. DAG entry node. L0-L1 only, no probing. Phase A (2026-06-01 harness-full-impl).
$comment_allowed_tool_types: Phase 2 (2026-06-12-redteam-phase2): subsidiary discovery (ENScan: 爱企查/天眼查/...) is an OSINT query against business-registry data — it DEFINES scope, does not probe the target — so it is allowed at L0 scoping. recon/osint is the tool_type ENScan maps to (tool_taxonomy.rs). The subsidiary coverage gate (see gate_rules + harness hook) only activates when the engagement opts in via --include-subsidiaries; otherwise scoping stays a no-op L0 authz confirmation (zero behaviour change).
$comment_gate_rules: Default (no --include-subsidiaries): scoping is L0 authz-confirmation (no probing), scope claim needs no tool evidence — coverage_complete is a no-op because expected_techniques is empty unless the harness hook dynamically injects GOLISH-INTEL-SUBSIDIARY (Phase 2). The evidence rules below only bite cells the model marks found/checked_empty, so they are inert with zero coverage cells.

on_fail.reason: every 'found' scoping coverage cell must cite evidence
hints: attach the subsidiary-discovery evidence id (recon_discover_subsidiaries) to each found cell

on_fail.reason: every 'checked_empty' scoping coverage cell must cite evidence (I8: checked-empty is NOT unchecked)
hints: attach the probe evidence id proving you actually ran subsidiary discovery on this org and it returned no qualifying child

gate_rules.$comment_authoritative: Phase 2 (2026-06-12-redteam-phase2): 'found' for GOLISH-INTEL-SUBSIDIARY is decided by DB truth (organizations table has a child org with parent_id = this engagement org), not self-report. expected_techniques is empty in this static spec; the harness hook injects GOLISH-INTEL-SUBSIDIARY ONLY when the engagement set --include-subsidiaries, so without the flag coverage_complete sees no expected techniques and is a no-op (zero回归).

on_fail.reason: subsidiary scoping incomplete: the org tree was never built (no qualifying child organization landed in the database)
hints: FIRST normalize each input company name via recon_lookup_company (canonical registered name, 以企查查为准) and create the root org with that canonical name (manage_organizations create / create_batch) — subsidiary discovery against a colloquial name misses

run recon_discover_subsidiaries on the engagement org so the enterprise-intel provider (ENScan) discovers investments/holdings and auto-promotes those clearing the ownership threshold into child organizations
the gate reads the DATABASE (organizations.parent_id), not your self-report — a cell is 'found' only if a real child org row landed
discovered subsidiaries but none cleared the threshold? that is checked_empty+evidence, not found — never fabricate
